summary: Paged two-column list widget embedded in menu screens: sixteen 0x10-byte row records at +0x74, a pager sub-object at +0x54, the total row count at +0x4C and a u16 row-id table pointer at +0x174.
evidence: Ctor 0x004C5088 installs vtable 0x777F94 and builds the +0x54 sub-object through func_00622248 (vtable 0x77F71C); SetPageRows 0x004C5154 walks sixteen rows at +0x74 and reads the row-id table pointer at +0x174; Init 0x004C4CD4 binds 'txt_l0'/'txt_r0' rows and pager_num_l/r.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Ctor 0x004C5088 writes 0x00777F94 at object base (CtorVariant writes 0x0077800C); the vtable holds Ui_PagedListWindow_Init/SetPageRows.

fields.name: maybe_rowCapacity
fields.evidence: Ctor writes 0x10 (16 rows) as puVar2[6] *after* func_00622248 advanced puVar2 to self+0x54, so the real address is self+0x6C (sub-object +0x18); struct_db projected it onto the pre-increment base as +0x18.

fields.name: maybe_ownerWindowMirror
fields.evidence: Ctor stores the owner argument as puVar2[7] through the same advanced pointer, i.e. the real store is +0x70 (see ownerWindow); this entry is the alias at +0x1C produced by the pointer reassignment.

fields.name: maybe_rowLimitSource
fields.evidence: SetPageRows 0x004C5154 does i = self[0xe]; cVar2 = (i != 0) ? (char)i->f_c : (char)i, and clamps the visible count against that value, so +0x38 points at an object whose +0xC is a row limit.

fields.name: rowCount
fields.evidence: SetPageRows: 'if (iVar3 < self[0x13])' tests the total entry count and 'self[0x13] + page * -0x10' derives the rows left on this page; Ui_List_SelectEntryById is bounded by it.

fields.name: pageRowCount
fields.evidence: SetPageRows clamps 'self[0x14] = clamp(rowCount - page*16, 1..16)' and passes 'self[0x14] - 1' to Ui_List_SelectEntryById, so it is the number of rows visible on the current page.

fields.name: pager
fields.evidence: Ctor default-constructs the sub-object at +0x54 through func_00622248; Init 0x004C4CD4 calls func_0062202C(self+0x15, rightId|0x10<<16, leftId|0x11<<16) which links the pager_num_r/pager_num_l panes.

fields.name: ownerWindow
fields.evidence: Ctor stores the owner argument at +0x70; Init reads self[0x1c] and copies 'owner + 0x11C' into every row record, i.e. the rows point at a u16 array owned by the owning window.

fields.name: unknown_0xd0
fields.evidence: Not a field access: the readable C line is the virtual call (**(code **)(*self + 0x34))(self,...); struct_db mis-read the vtable-slot offset as a member address.

fields.name: unknown_0xe0
fields.evidence: Not a field access: (**(code **)(*self + 0x38)) is a vtable-slot call that struct_db attributed to +0xE0.

fields.name: unknown_0x160
fields.evidence: Not a field access: (**(code **)(*self + 0x58))(self) is the vtable slot that returns the entry list; +0x160 is a decompiler artefact.

fields.name: rowIdTable
fields.evidence: Ui_ListRow_SetFlaggedValueText(self + i*0x10 + 0x74, *(u16 *)(self[0x5d] + idx*2)) reads a u16 row-id array through the pointer at +0x174 (self[0x5d]).
